newsitem.title: ITALY: De Benedetti aide tipped to take over at Olivetti.
newsitem.headline: De Benedetti aide tipped to take over at Olivetti.

text.p: Roberto Colaninno, managing director of auto components firm Sogefi and a close associate of Carlo De Benedetti, has been tipped to take over from Francesco Caio as chief executive of Olivetti, market sources said on Wednesday.
Olivetti has called an extraordinary board meeting which is scheduled to begin at 1600 GMT but has given no details of what is on the agenda.
Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said on Wednesday that chief executive Francesco Caio was likely either to resign or to be ousted only three months after taking up the post.
Market sources said they understood that Colaninno had agreed to take over from Caio who would announce at the board meeting that he was stepping down.
Sogefi is controlled by De Benedetti's industrial holding company CIR.
A spokeswoman for Olivetti declined comment on the reports. --Milan newsroom +392-66102321
